msg: Divide the coloured gnomes between 2 groups: purle and bright colours (group1) and pink and dark colours (group 2). Be on the lookout for patterns and switch between group 1 and 2, sometimes you will see that gnomes from group 1 will have more mushrooms than group w, however this will change throughout. Look out for patterns keeping in mind the two groups and when you see that sticking to one group doesn't work anymore try with the other group. Think as a choice between two groups, whereby the patterns of mushrooms will change accross the game. Avoid always sticking to the same group; look for patterns and change when needed. Also, do not continuisly move between groups. be careful not to time out, that would prevent you from monitoring patterns. If you can try remember the specific colour of each knome you select since sometimesit will always carry the same amount. To summarise, keep in mind the 2 groups, look out for patterns, keep in mind that the patterns will change and when they do so be flexible, stay concentrated an never timeout
